summary: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a securities purchase agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC for up to $10 million in Secured Pre-Paid Purchases of Class A common stock plus 450,000 pre-delivery shares. The deal includes customary covenants, an Exchange Cap under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d), and shareholder approval obtained on June 30, 2026. This is a capital-raising transaction involving a registered investment, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report on a definitive agreement for equity-linked financing.
